## About
Rick's Power Muffler, or RPM, works on exhaust systems and nothing else. From simple welds to complex custom dual exhaust, if it's exhaust or related to it, we can make it or repair it, for any make or model.
The shop is owned and operated by Rick Soto, and he's the one you'll talk to when you pull in. He listens to what you want, then recommends the best setup for you and your car. We use high quality parts, matched to your vehicle, and we keep prices competitive so the work is easier on your budget.
You'll find us on W Van Buren St in Phoenix, close to the freeways, so we're an easy drive from around the valley.

## Services
- Custom dual exhaust: Complete custom dual exhaust systems built for your car or truck.
- Custom cat-back systems: Cat-back systems fabricated to fit your vehicle and the sound you're after.
- High performance replacements: High performance replacement exhaust for when you want more than stock.
- Catalytic converters: Generic, OEM compatible, California OBD II and diesel catalytic converters, plus custom manifold converter fabrication.
- Diesel exhaust systems: Exhaust work for diesel trucks, including diesel catalytic converters.
- Welding: Aluminum, stainless steel and MIG welding.
- Chrome tips: Chrome exhaust tips to finish off the look.

## FAQ
Q: Where is the shop?
A: We're at 3846 W Van Buren in Phoenix.

Q: Will you tell me about other problems you notice?
A: Yes. Rick will point out spots that might need attention while he's working on your exhaust.

Q: Are you open on Sunday?
A: No, the shop is closed on Sunday.
